system.concept: Ventrue “entertainer” and hidden Camarilla intelligence asset, childe of the fled Tai-pan Robert Pedder

backgrounds.name: Mentor
backgrounds.notes: Robert Pedder, her sire, now departed

system.biography:
Background

Anticipating Hong Kong's eventual return to China, the old Tai-pan Robert Pedder cultivated the perfect sleeper agent in Camille T'sien, the Eurasian byblow of a Cantonese artist and a French diplomat's wife. Pedder seduced, Dominated, and eventually Embraced and Blood Bound her, engineering the removal of both men in her life so she depended entirely on him. He trained her as an elite “entertainer” whose upper-crust patrons formed a Who's Who of British and Chinese power. Camille has spent decades reporting the secrets of these men to her sire, and now that Pedder has fled with the rest of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}'s Kindred, she remains behind as his and the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}'s agent, tasked above all with learning what she can of the Kuei-jin's predicted “Sixth Age.” Her Eurasian features make her far less conspicuously Western than most Kindred, and she hopes this lets her pass more easily among the Cathayan vampires who do not yet know she exists.

Image

A petite (4'11") beauty with elaborately styled long black hair, delicate mixed Chinese-European features, and an unmistakable sexual allure balanced with youthful innocence.

Roleplaying Hints

Dutifully serves her sire's purpose but is genuinely frightened of the Kuei-jin, about whom she has had almost no direct contact; hopes desperately that Pedder has kept her hidden well enough that they don't know she exists.

Haven

A primary haven in the Central District (slated for redevelopment) and a private cottage in Aberdeen.
system.notes: Disciplines (as printed): Auspex 2, Celerity 1, Dominate 4, Obfuscate 2, Presence 4, Protean 2. Sire: Robert Pedder (Blood Bound to him; he has since fled Hong Kong). Secret: her existence as a vampire is concealed even from most of Kindred society.

system.description: By meeting your subject's gaze and winning a Mental Challenge, you implant a more complex command, optionally tied to a specific trigger event, to be carried out immediately or later.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: By winning a Mental Challenge while holding your victim's gaze, you can erase, alter, or implant up to fifteen minutes of memory per challenge, or question the subject to recall details they otherwise might not share.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: By hissing and baring your vampiric features in a Social Challenge, you strike terror into a victim who, if defeated, flees and avoids you for the rest of the scene or hour, risking an extra Trait to act against you if cornered.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

items.name: Presence — 2 Intermediate — Command the Wary Steed

system.description:
Through use of this power the Cainite can cause enemies' mounts to rear and bolt, singly or en masse, by the strength of his gaze alone, or bolster the courage and tractability of allied steeds for greater control in battle.

System: The player spends a Willpower point and rolls Manipulation + Animal Ken (difficulty 7). Enemy mounts become terrified and nigh uncontrollable: Ride roll difficulties increase by three and mounted combat becomes impossible. Friendly mounts become far more pliant (-2 difficulty on all Ride rolls) and may be coerced into situations they would normally avoid.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Three: Zealots

vtmlarp.source: World of Darkness: Hong Kong (Hong Kong by Night), Chapter Four: The Spirits' Children
